summary: Researched promoting the 4 scratch witness probes into CslibTests/. WitnessProbe.lean (~6.5s), WitnessSearch3.lean (~2.7s) are fast and promotable as-is via the #guard_msgs idiom. MinProbe.lean (~2.5s) has a doc-comment-before-#eval! parse error to fix first. WitnessSearch2.lean's exhaustive subset search times out (>9m, zero output) and must be replaced with specific-witness assertions, not ported whole. Registration is via CslibTests.lean barrel + lake exe mk_all --module.
decisions_made: Keep original probe base names (WitnessProbe/WitnessSearch2/WitnessSearch3/MinProbe) under CslibTests/ to minimize churn at the Scheme.lean citation sites
WitnessSearch2.lean's full powerset enumeration must NOT be executed in CI; assert only specific known witnesses instead
Convert all bare #eval!/doc-comment-before-#eval patterns to the /-- info: ... -/ #guard_msgs in #eval idiom used by BetaSplitRefutation.lean
dead_ends: Running WitnessSearch2.lean's searchWitness for phiRef1 via lake env lean: no output after 9m10s timeout, confirms it is not CI-viable as written
decisions_deferred: Updating Scheme.lean/Minimal/Completeness.lean's 'not CI-protected' citations is flagged as an out-of-scope follow-up (file_scope is CslibTests/ only)
